response.overview: When 13-year-old Nisha insults the powerful village Sarpanch, she’s chased by his vengeful son from bus stop to home. Scared and tired, she starts having nightmares about a ghostly woman. But soon, Nisha learns the ghost is actually her grandmother, who had once stood up to the same injustice.Inspired by her, Nisha finds the strength to stand her ground and reclaim her dignity.
response.title: झाडावर कोरलेली गोष्ट
